notes:
cer_canadas_energy_future: Canadian energy and macroeconomic projections conditional on the selected report edition and policy scenario.
  - macro-indicators: Canada-level real GDP, deflator and exchange-rate series; macroeconomic paths provide provincial transport-demand growth proxies and currency-conversion inputs.
dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with reviewed port-count mixes, rated-power trajectories and CAD2022 equipment/installation costs per port. Convert total port expenditure divided by total rated power to model costs. Common 0.20 utilization is a user-reviewed consistency override for vintage-indexed limits, not a direct source observation; final cost/power values beyond 2040 retain the reviewed endpoint.
nlr_alternative_fueling_infrastructure: U.S. residential L1 installation cost midpoint of 550 USD per port from the 100–1000 USD range; equipment cost is zero. The 2021 dollar year is a reviewed manual basis, not explicitly stated in the source table. Normalize to rated power only after currency conversion and port-count aggregation.
